title: Laser plasma as explanation for the Tic Tac
place_text: off the coast of San Diego

tellings.quote:
>> Yes, it would from a kinematic point of
view. But the visuals don't line up.

plain: A glowing ball of plasma made by a laser could explain how the Tic Tac moved: that is the white oval object, shaped like the mint, that Navy pilots said they chased off San Diego in 2004. Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the National Security Agency (the US agency that collects electronic intelligence), considers the idea and says the motion fits but "the visuals don't line up" with what the pilots described. So in his view the laser idea does not settle the case.
